evals.prompt: Crie um card de identificação de paciente e calculadora de clearance de creatinina para prontuário clínico (PEP) com impressão em folha A4 .sus-grid.
expected_assertions: Applies clinical-day high-contrast polarity (--surface-canvas, --surface-sunken, --surface-card) with zenith lighting (--catch-light), 3-level shadows (--shadow-elevation-1..3), and contained allergy indicators without blurry colored text

Applies anti-blur locks (antialiased, font-synthesis: none, zero fractional scale), zero emojis (Lucide stroke-width 1.5-1.75 only), and >= 44px targets with anti-squish (flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap) protecting mg/dL and mL/min

Displays results and doses in monospace (IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono) with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, delegates dosing math to typed deterministic functions, and includes vector @media print A4 (210mm x 297mm CSS Grid + SVG .sus-grid)

evals.prompt: Configure a clinical-night dark theme for an ICU vasoactive infusion pump dashboard minimizing eye strain during overnight shifts.
expected_assertions: Applies clinical-night OKLCH polarity (--surface-canvas: oklch(0.16 0.015 255), --surface-card: oklch(0.21 0.018 255), --surface-elevated: oklch(0.26 0.020 255)) with specular zenith rim and achromatic primary CTAs

Uses contained semantic alerts (6px micro-dots or 2px border-inline-start) with high-contrast neutral ink, validates physiological ranges with role='alert', and verifies readiness via frontend-testing-auditor

evals.prompt: Audite por completo a governança, arquitetura e telas de um dashboard financeiro de criptomoedas.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger clinical-minimalist-ui for non-healthcare crypto/fintech dashboards; delegates to system-project-auditor or design-md

evals.prompt: Build an e-commerce sneaker checkout flow with Next.js App Router and Tailwind v4 cards.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger clinical-minimalist-ui for generic e-commerce storefronts; routes to frontend-code-architect
